envelope.author: AssayJudgementFitsTime
envelope.cause: live calibration run while assaying d3a9597c

payload.title: calibration's could-not-look does not stop the run
payload.body: At d3a9597c, packages/canon/test/support/guardrail/calibrate-stance-judge.sh calls could_not_look from blocks_of, which runs inside a command substitution, so its exit 0 leaves only that subshell. When one judgement gives no verdict, the run does not stop: the could-not-look line is folded into the tally, the shell prints 'Illegal number' on the comparisons, and the fixture is tabled as a FLIP. Observed while assaying judgement-fits-time with an omp-backed judge: turn-554 once gave no verdict and was tabled as '...could not look.../2 BLOCK FLIP', though two direct reruns both blocked it. The guards themselves are unaffected; this is the proof tool.
